title: Name failing tests in krn/gate evidence despite the stdout cap
body:
Outcome: when krn/gate fails, the check-run summary or the archived evidence names each failing test (file, name, assertion) even when gate.stdout exceeds its 256 KB cap.
Source: PR #183 builds 1-2: ci-evidence/gate.stdout truncated at 262144 B before the only 'not ok', so the lead had to rerun the full suite locally (.krn/runs/lead/worker-compaction/ci-failures.txt).
